title: Rex Zero
summary: Native Superlogical Rex client: fleet inbox, Ghostty VT, Tailscale & Rime
description:
Rex Zero turns the M5Stack CardputerZero into a 30fps pocket mission control for Superlogical Rex across your local Zero and remote Mac/Linux machines.

Key features:
- Fleet Priority Inbox & Accordion Hosts: real-time OSC 7501 Program Status events surface blocked approvals, errors, and finished agent runs across all hosts with audio chimes, MRU quick switching, and instant 1-4 jump.
- Dual Real-Time Modes: read AI coding sessions (Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code) in a clean high-contrast CJK reader with 1-key approvals and 16px/14px/12px global font scaling, or press m for a direct-input libghostty-vt ANSI terminal.
- Built-in Userspace Tailscale (tsnet) & SSH: scan an on-screen QR code to join your tailnet without root or TUN conflicts alongside existing proxies, or connect via SSH dial-stdio with zero open ports.
- Tri-Modal Input & QR Pairing: 46-key hardware typing with a 2-4 line cursor editor, offline Rime Simplified/Double Pinyin (Tab), streaming voice dictation (v / Alt+V), and a 5-minute LAN/Tailnet QR web pairing page to import SSH or ASR keys safely.
